entries.answer:
My prior answer was too broad after correctly identifying the blocking parse failure. It incorrectly reported downstream runtime failures as if they were independently reachable in the supplied program, even though the syntax error at line 2596 prevents the entire third script block from compiling and executing. It also split one malformed, apparently truncated syntax-highlighting implementation into multiple “errors,” contrary to your requirement not to merge or invent errors.

1. [file-1.html:2596] — `SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression … Unmatched ')'`: the expression beginning `if(/^\\/\\/|...` is syntactically invalid, so script block 3 (lines 2412–3490) fails to compile and none of its contents execute.
2. [file-1.html:2615] — Broken reference: `highlightCode(line, lang)` refers to no declared `highlightCode` function anywhere in the document; this becomes reachable only after the blocking syntax error at line 2596 is corrected.
3. [file-1.html:2595–2605] — Broken/truncated implementation: `classifyToken(token, lang)` contains undeclared `re` and `source` references and highlighter-loop logic rather than a token-classification return path; after line 2596 is corrected sufficiently for execution to reach the loop, it fails at `re.exec(source)` because `re` is not defined in this function scope.

END OF ERROR LIST.
